title: Meet Orin — the protagonist of my evolving game idea, Lumen Road
author: Chappie831

comments.author: jaykrown
comments.body: Good for posting it here. Best to be transparent about using AI. There are a lot of people trying to make it seem like they didn't use AI when it's obvious, and it's a bit ridiculous.

replies.author: Chappie831
replies.body:
People love to accuse others of AI use. It’s like identifying a Witch!   
![gif](giphy|m1N0Z3nARla8O0fUiZ)

replies.author: Chappie831
replies.body:
I use AI just to tidy things up but the ideas are mine. The designs are mine. 

I just don’t like the discouragement. But I’m excited to start creating my game nonetheless
